description: This file defines the class CppWrapperMps, which extends CppWrapperGpu to generate and manage C++ code for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) kernels, including kernel call helpers, code generation for MPS-specific kernel invocation, and singleton management for shader libraries. It integrates with the broader code generation framework, utilizing methods to create kernel calls, manage shader libraries, and generate necessary include paths.
